name: Cross-Asset Volatility-Scaled Defensive Trend (Partial Spec)
rule_description: Allocate across defensive Treasury and Gold ETFs inversely proportional to 20-day realized volatility when regime stress rises; exact stop threshold is omitted in the public abstract.
raw_text: Public abstract describing inverse-volatility allocation across TLT, GLD, and SHY spot ETFs. Explicitly non-martingale and without grid. Exact bar timeframe and stop-loss multiplier are omitted.
